what: Inside the section, the image frame stays pinned to the screen and rests for 2 beats. Over 1 beat, a speech-bubble-like overlay layer switches on while the image grows to 1.5x (1.2x under 1024px) and is pulled toward one lower side by .39 of the screen width and .3 of the height (3 beats), then holds for 5 beats. Into the vacated space, the side text (a vertical-writing sentence) rises to be read. It starts when the point half a screen height below the section top reaches the screen center and ends when the section bottom reaches the screen bottom (no spacing gap, scrub 1.1). Giving x a negative value moves it to the opposite side

options.[data-fx-part=zoom]: Plate pulled along as it grows, default pin
options.[data-fx-part=overlay]: (if present) overlay layer that switches on
options.x · y: Drag distance (multiple of screen width · height), default .390625 · .3 — to the left use x: -.390625
options.at: Start — when the point a few screen-heights below the section top edge reaches screen center, default .5

from.where: index.html #kg-campus1-trigger (toward bottom right) · #kg-campus2-trigger (x: -.390625, toward bottom left) — a layer of speech bubbles turns on over an isometric lounge illustration. Original start: .5*innerHeight+" center" · end bottom bottom · anticipatePin 1 · scrub 1.1 · isPC ? 1.5 : 1.2
